title: Plant Manager IV
text:
PLANT MANAGER
 
 
**About Voltava:** 
At Voltava, people power everything we do. We are a premier global manufacturing and assembly partner formed through the combination of Detroit Manufacturing Systems, Android Industries, and Avancez with approximately 5,400 Team Members across 21 facilities worldwide. Our vibrant, collaborative, and people-focused culture is the foundation for everything we deliver, from complex module assembly and sequencing to contract manufacturing, supply chain, automation, and tooling and equipment design for OEM customers across the automotive, industrial, e-mobility, heavy truck, defense, and technology sectors. Kinetyc, our scalable contract manufacturing arm based in Wixom, Michigan, expands our capabilities and capacity to support customers across a range of industries. Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
 
 
**About the Role:** 
**At Voltava, we're Building Better Manufacturing:** operations where people, technology, and operational excellence come together to deliver exceptional results.
 
As Plant Manager, you will run the full production operation for your customer-centric unit, including Materials, Assembly, Shipping, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering. You own results in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, profitability, and people, and you build the leadership bench that sustains them.
 
This is a highly visible role for a leader who pairs operational depth and business acumen with a servant leadership mindset. You will build an engaged, high-performing culture while leading deployment of VIBE (Voltava Business System) and the Daily Management System (DMS), continuous improvement, and the adoption of AI, automation, and best-in-class manufacturing technology on the shop floor.
 
 
**What You Will Do:** 

* Own plant performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, profitability, and employee engagement.
* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing leadership team, with real succession depth at every level.
* Champion servant leadership grounded in trust, accountability, collaboration, and employee development.
* Turn employee feedback into visible action that improves employee experience.
* Use KPIs and operational data to track performance, solve problems at the root, and drive continuous improvement.
* Lead implementation of VIBE (Voltava Business System) at the plant, embedding Lean Manufacturing, standardized work, 5S, and PFEP as the daily operating system.
* Own plant adoption of the Daily Management System (DMS): establish daily routines for reviewing performance, escalating and solving problems, and holding leaders accountable for consistent execution.
* Lead innovation and the implementation of AI solutions, automation, and advanced technology that modernize the shop floor and improve safety, quality, productivity, profitability, and efficiency.
* Sustain compliance with EHS, IATF 16949, ISO 14001, and quality and regulatory requirements.
* Secure the staffing, resources, and capabilities needed to meet production and financial objectives.
* Partner across functions on new business, quoting, capacity planning, customer requirements, and improvement initiatives.

**What You Need To Be Successful:** 

* 10+ years of automotive manufacturing experience, including 5+ years in progressively senior leadership roles.
* Track record leading high-performing manufacturing operations and developing strong leadership teams.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Experience implementing and sustaining an operating system and daily management routines; familiarity with VIBE (Voltava Business System) and Daily Management System (DMS) is a plus.
* Servant leadership mindset, with demonstrated success building culture, engagement, accountability, and talent.
* Experience using KPIs and operational data to improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Strong financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills in a manufacturing environment.
* Preferred: experience championing innovation, automation, AI, or emerging manufacturing technologies.
* Clear communicator and collaborator who can influence and lead at every level of the organization.

**What Success Looks Like:** 
Success means a plant where people are engaged, leaders are empowered, VIBE and DMS drive consistent daily execution, technology enables better performance, and operational excellence is part of how we work every day.
 
 
**You will know you are making an impact when:** 

* Safety is part of the culture, and leaders and team members take ownership every day.
* The plant delivers consistent results in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, profitability, and customer satisfaction.
* Employee engagement keeps improving, with real follow-through on feedback.
* Leaders model servant leadership and create an environment of trust, accountability, collaboration, respect, and development.
* Innovation projects and new technologies, including AI and advanced manufacturing solutions, are implemented and deliver measurable improvements on the shop floor and in the office.
* Teams embrace continuous improvement and keep finding smarter, safer, more efficient ways to work.
* VIBE and the Daily Management System are fully implemented and sustained, with daily management routines running consistently, leaders accountable for them, and results that hold.
* The leadership pipeline is strong, with talented team members developed and ready for their next role.
* Customers see consistent quality, reliable delivery, and a true partnership with Voltava.

**Education:** 

* Bachelor's degree required (Management, Business, or Engineering); MBA or master's degree in Business Management preferred.

**Travel:** 

* Up to 25%

**What We Offer:** 
Our team members are our greatest investment. Our total rewards package supports you at every stage of your career and life, and may include comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage; retirement savings with employer contributions; tuition reimbursement; paid time off and holidays; employee assistance resources; and wellness programs that support your health, financial well-being, and professional growth.
 
 
**Our Core Values:** 
Voltava is committed to creating an environment where every Team Member feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to make an impact.
 

* Respect: We create belonging by bringing out the best in each other.
* Integrity: We earn trust through every interaction.
* Courage: We show up fully even when it would be easier not to.
* Impact: We strengthen the people and places around us.

Together, we are Building A Better Everything.
 
Voltava is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
We are committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
At Voltava, employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce strengthens our ability to innovate, serve our customers, and achieve our goals.
 
Accessibility and Accommodations
 
Voltava is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and during employment. If you require assistance or an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact careers@voltava.com. Requests for accommodation will be reviewed and considered in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
